passive.name: Searing Brilliance
passive.description:
Whenever Mel uses an ability, she gains three bonus projectiles (up to nine maximum) on her next attack.

When Mel deals damage through an ability or attack, she applies Overwhelm, which can stack infinitely. If the enemy is hit by Mel with enough Overwhelm damage, the stacks are consumed to execute the target.

spells.name: Radiant Volley
spells.description: Mel fires a barrage of projectiles that explode around a target location, dealing damage repeatedly to enemies within the area.
spells.tooltip:
Mel unleashes a barrage of {{ explosioncount }} projectiles that explode in the area around a target location.

The first explosion hit deals {{ initialexplosiondamage }} magic damage and each subsequent explosion deals {{ totalexplosiondamage }} magic damage, adding up to {{ alldamagehit }} magic damage total.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Rebuttal
spells.description: Mel forms a barrier around herself that reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker, prevents her from taking damage, and grants her movement speed.
spells.tooltip:
Mel forms a barrier around herself that reflects projectiles from enemy champions, gaining {{ shieldamount }} Shields for {{ duration }} seconds and {{ movespeed*100 }}% decaying Move Speed for {{ movespeedduration }} seconds.

Reflected projectiles deal {{ damagepercent }} original damage as magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Solar Snare
spells.description: Mel fires a radiant orb forward, rooting those at its center while the area around it slows enemies and deals damage over time.
spells.tooltip:
Mel fires a radiating orb, Rooting enemies at its center for {{ rootduration }} seconds and dealing {{ damage }} magic damage.

The orb builds up a hostile area around it that Slows enemies by {{ areaslowamount*100 }}% and deals {{ areadamagepersecond }} magic damage per second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Golden Eclipse
spells.description:
Mel strikes all enemies marked with Overwhelm regardless of their distance from her, dealing additional damage for each stack of Overwhelm.

Ranks of Golden Eclipse increase Overwhelm's damage.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Overwhelm damage is increased to {{ passiveflatdamage }} magic damage plus {{ passivestackdamage }} magic damage per stack.

Active: Mel unleashes her power on all enemies affected by Overwhelm, dealing {{ ultflatdamage }} magic damage plus {{ ultstackdamage }} magic damage per Overwhelm stack.

Can only be cast when an enemy champion is affected by Overwhelm.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

variants.name: Searing Brilliance
effects: Innate: Mel's damaging basic attacks and abilities apply a stack of Overwhelm to enemies for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking infinitely.

Overwhelm: Store 50 / 60 / 70 / 80 (based on Golden Eclipse's rank) (+ 10% AP) magic damage on the affected enemy with the first stack, reduced[ to 60% ][ to 30 / 36 / 42 / 48 (based on Golden Eclipse's rank) (+ 6% AP) ]against minions. For each stack, store an additional 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 (based on Golden Eclipse's rank) (+ 0.75% AP) magic damage on the target. If the total post-mitigation damage stored exceeds the target's current health and shields, the next stack will consume them all to deal the damage.

Innate - Searing Brilliance: Mel's ability casts each generate 3 stacks of Searing Brilliance for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 9 times. Her next basic attack consumes all stacks of Searing Brilliance to additionally fire an equal number of blazing projectiles at the target. Each projectile deals 8 : 25 (based on level) (+ 1% AP) magic damage.

variants.name: Radiant Volley
effects: The bolts momentarily grant sight during their travel, while the explosions grant sight over their target area. Both can see through brush and terrain.

variants.name: Rebuttal
effects: Active: Mel forms a protective barrier around herself for 0.75 seconds, becoming invulnerable to non- turret damage and gaining 30% decaying bonus movement speed. All hostile non-turret projectiles that collide with the barrier will be destroyed instantly before Mel fires the same projectiles as her own, either toward or in the direction of the original sources, or toward herself.
